dogecoin.text: One of my best friends, who called my long-standing interest in Bitcoin “a phase,” has now thrown $3000 behind Dogecoin at all time highs. My group chat won’t shut up about El*n M*sk being on SNL and how that will pump the coin. I hope they all make money but this can’t end well.

I reject the notion of the “meme economy.” It does not exist. Neither is there merely a family resemblance of meme concepts that resists extension to the economy as such. There is no boundary. All of this is economics. Real economics. The truth of Bitcoin IS Dogecoin, and so on.
